contexts.text: Dusky, and as it were sooty caves...
All, when looked into, appear shady and dusky...
Their opposites, which are fiery duskiness and black...
As so many dusky and fiery devils...
If the love of self makes the head, he appears from Heaven with a dusky face.
The hatreds and revenges themselves appear like dusky fires, and like bright fires; the hatreds, like dusky fires...
He hurried into a cave, around which appeared a dusky fieriness; a sign that they had no faith nor charity.
Dusky clouds appear above the Hells, (which) signify the falsification and profanation of truth.
With some, the interiors appear dusky from the rejection of spiritual things.
